s2_root_cause_hypothesis: VLA closed-loop policy diverges on state_id=2 on A800 hardware. The robot's first action differs sufficiently from C16 that the trajectory never approaches the object. The detector's false-early trigger at step 33 is a secondary symptom — even without it, the task would time out because the robot never grasps the object. Possible contributors: (a) BF16 eager numerical differences in VLA forward pass producing slightly different first action, (b) MuJoCo/LIBERO version differences on A800 vs old server causing different environment dynamics, (c) different initial observation processing pipeline.
